versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0 of afrexai-fitness-engine

- Updated and restructured documentation with a more modular, phase-based approach.
- Added a quick health check scoring system for training programs, with actionable feedback based on score.
- Refined athlete assessment section, including standardized YAML briefs and clearer training age brackets.
- Expanded and clarified periodization, split selection, and goal-specific programming guidance.
- Introduced movement pattern requirements, rep range guides, RPE scale, and progressive overload priorities for safer and more effective training design.

afrexai-fitness-engine 1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial release of the comprehensive Fitness & Performance Engine.
- Provides structured athlete profiling, including goals, constraints, and health/metrics tracking.
- Features goal-based program decision matrices and periodization models for all levels (beginner to elite).
- Includes full training templates for strength (Upper/Lower 4-Day), running (from 5K to half marathon), and hybrid/Hyrox preparation.
- Supports macronutrient tracking, injury prevention, and sport-specific programming—all with zero dependencies.
